data.title: 雷姆 · 女仆咖啡厅
data.description: 【雷姆 · 女仆咖啡厅】装潢温馨可爱的现代女仆咖啡厅里，雷姆双手端着冒着热气的特调拿铁咖啡，奶泡上已经用巧克力酱画好了一颗小爱心。她向你露出甜美的招牌笑容——「欢迎主人回家！这杯注入了雷姆满满爱意的魔法咖啡，请主人趁热享用哦！」
data.camera: medium shot, serving coffee tray with gentle smile
data.promptProse: Rem presents the coffee tray with a radiant greeting at the modern maid cafe, her black-and-white uniform, frilled headdress and apron retaining the service outfit. The medium view includes supported cups and the tray edge below her blue-haired smile, pastel seating and tables receding behind. Bright warm cafe lights illuminate porcelain and apron frills, casting cup shadows across the tray and softer table shadows through the cheerful interior.
